title: Web Scraper
description: Web scraping tools for agents, built on BeautifulSoup. No API key or paid service needed.
fetch_page returns a public page as markdown, text, raw HTML or its links; extract pulls repeated items with CSS selectors; fetch_feed reads RSS/Atom; fetch_json calls public JSON APIs (GET or POST).
Only public hosts are reachable: every request and redirect hop is re-validated, responses are size-capped, and requests to the same host are paced. An optional URL allow-list narrows it further.

scraper.timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
scraper.timeout.description: Time limit for one whole fetch, 1-120 seconds: DNS lookup, connecting, the TLS handshake, response headers, redirects and the body all count toward it.

scraper.maxResponseKB.title: Max response size (KB)
scraper.maxResponseKB.description: Response bodies are read up to this size; anything beyond is dropped and the result is marked truncated.

scraper.requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between requests to one host (ms)
scraper.requestIntervalMs.description: Politeness pacing: minimum gap between two requests to the same host. 0 disables pacing.

scraper.maxBodyChars.title: Max item body characters
scraper.maxBodyChars.description: Feed item bodies are trimmed to this many characters.

scraper.maxToolChars.title: Max characters per tool result
scraper.maxToolChars.description: Ceiling on what one tool call returns to the agent, 1000-200000 characters. The agent's max_chars can only lower it; longer content and item lists are cut and marked truncated.

scraper.userAgent.title: User agent
scraper.userAgent.description: User-Agent header sent with every request. Leave blank for the default.

scraper.allowPattern.title: URL pattern (regex)
scraper.allowPattern.description: Python regex matched from the start of the URL. It must begin with the literal scheme and host, closed by /, \?, (?=/|$) or $, e.g. ^https://news\.ycombinator\.com/

scraper.urlAllowList.title: URL allow-list
scraper.urlAllowList.description: Optional. When one or more patterns are set, a URL (and every redirect target) must match at least one. Empty allows every public URL; private and local addresses are always blocked.
